bridge-type.label: Ambiance AmpliPi Controller
bridge-type.description: An Ambiance AmpliPi controller (radio + announcements + alarm).

parameter.name: hostname
parameter.label: Hostname
parameter.description: Hostname or IP address of the Ambiance AmpliPi controller.

parameter.name: refreshInterval
parameter.label: Refresh Interval
parameter.description: Interval the controller is polled, in seconds.

thing-type.label: Ambiance AmpliPi Zone
thing-type.description: A zone of the Ambiance AmpliPi system.

channel-type.label: Source
channel-type.description: The playback source that owns the audio path (radio, spotify, ...). Options come from the controller's source list; selecting one switches to and starts it.

channel-type.label: Station
channel-type.description: The radio station that is playing. Options come from the controller's station list.

channel-type.label: Artist
channel-type.description: Current artist (parsed from the stream title).

channel-type.label: Track
channel-type.description: Current track (parsed from the stream title).

channel-type.label: Album art
channel-type.description: Current album art (fetched by the controller from the now-playing metadata).

channel-type.label: Siren
channel-type.description: Burglar siren: ON drives all zones to full and loops the alarm; OFF restores.

channel-type.label: Announce
channel-type.description: URL of audio to play as a public-address announcement.

channel-type.label: Audio Health OK
channel-type.description: ON while the controller's audio subsystem (radio + preamp) is healthy; OFF when it needs attention.

channel-type.label: Audio Health
channel-type.description: "ok", or a human-readable summary of what the controller reported wrong (radio / preamp).
